_about: Learned-model experiments, dev tier (2022) only, 3 demo stations. Same 320 cases per arm from the shared harness (backend/app/evaluate.py case generator); F1 headline = loss >= 20% and ramp >= 7 d. Scratch-run results, not tuned on; source: board RESULT posts 2026-11-07.

seq_unguarded.what: 65k-param dilated 1D conv, last 64 cycles, trained on 560k cycles from 21 untouched stations, 110 s on M5 Max
seq_unguarded.finding: about 4x tighter on normal, but learns a slow decline as normal

seq_guarded.what: same model, context ends 14 days before the predicted cycle

f1_headline.note: 9 cases unscored for lack of context, counted as misses

seq_guarded.finding: no longer learns the fault, but predictions are too blurry to help

verdict: Kept the physics + statistics detector; each learned model taught us why the 14-day guard and sibling comparison exist.
